title: Oru Nalla Naal Paathu Solren
desc: Yaman, a tribal leader, arrives in Chennai to kidnap the woman whom he has sworn to marry. However, the woman's classmates pose as an obstacle in his plans.

title: Middle Class Madhavan
desc: An advocate and the breadwinner of his family finds it difficult to appreciate his married life because of his problems.

title: Chatrapathy
desc: A bus driver kills a group of criminals working for a local politician. Later, the politician realises that the man is an army major hellbent on revenge.

title: Gethu
desc: When Thulasi Raman, a teacher, is falsely accused of killing a man, his son Sethu, a librarian, sets out to find the real culprit.

title: Aambala
desc: Three brothers head to their native village to reconcile with their estranged relatives. However, a corrupt politician seeks to cause misunderstandings among them for his selfish interests.
